name: A Real-World Leaf Image Dataset of Seven Bangladeshi Medicinal Plant Species
description: A curated collection of 13,095 leaf images (6,700 raw and 6,395 pre-processed) across seven medicinal plant species native to Bangladesh, photographed in outdoor natural environments across varying lighting conditions for species identification and morphological plant analysis.
